tasks.name: 创建博客和图片模型
tasks.description: 创建 Blog 和 Image 模型用于存储博客和图片信息。在 app/models/ 目录下创建 blog.py 和 image.py，Blog 模型包含字段: id, title, content, created_at；Image 模型包含字段: id, blog_id, image_url, uploaded_at。

tasks.name: 创建博客和图片API
tasks.description: 创建博客和图片的 CRUD API 路由。在 app/routes/ 下创建 blogs.py，包含博客的增删改查接口，以及支持图片上传的接口。确保图片上传后存储路径正确。

tasks.name: 实现图片上传功能
tasks.description: 在后端实现图片上传逻辑。在 app/services/ 下创建 image_upload.py，处理图片的存储和验证逻辑，确保支持常见图片格式 (jpg, png, gif)。

tasks.name: 创建博客前端页面
tasks.description: 创建博客管理的前端页面。在 templates/ 下创建 blog.html，包含博客标题、内容输入框，以及图片上传功能的表单。

tasks.name: 实现博客列表和详情页面
tasks.description: 创建博客列表和详情展示页面。在 templates/ 下创建 blog_list.html 和 blog_detail.html，分别显示所有博客和单个博客的详细信息，包括图片。

T1.implementation_approach: Define models for Blog and Image in the database, including fields like title, content, and image references.
T1.notes: Ensure proper relationships between Blog and Image models for easy querying.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs for creating, reading, updating, and deleting blogs and images using a framework like Django REST Framework.
T2.notes: Include pagination and filtering for blog listing API.

T3.implementation_approach: Implement an image upload feature using a library like Cloudinary or local storage, with validation for file type and size.
T3.notes: Ensure secure handling of uploaded files to prevent vulnerabilities.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a frontend page using a framework like React or Vue.js to allow users to create and edit blogs with image upload functionality.
T4.notes: Integrate the blog API for seamless data submission and retrieval.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop pages to display a list of blogs and individual blog details, fetching data from the API and rendering it dynamically.
T5.notes: Include responsive design and optimize for performance.
